summary.whatChanges: Pins the CI Bun version to 1.3.9 instead of "latest", and bumps the private @trpc/tests package to version 11.17.0 along with its @trpc/client and @trpc/server dependencies.
behaviorChanges: CI example tests now run on Bun 1.3.9 rather than whatever Bun release is latest
The internal tests package declares a version field (11.17.0) and depends on tRPC client/server 11.17.0 instead of 11.16.0
risks: Pinned Bun version will drift and must be bumped manually to pick up fixes
Test package now requires @trpc/client and @trpc/server 11.17.0 to be resolvable; if those versions aren't published/linked in the workspace, installs could fail
